offers_products.reason: Manufactures paints, coatings, sealants and specialty materials for automotive, aerospace, packaging and architectural markets.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is overwhelmingly from coatings products; services like color matching or technical support are incidental.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Architectural paint and stain brands reach homeowners and DIY shoppers through retailers and company-owned stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells coatings to automakers, aerospace firms, industrial manufacturers, packaging makers, collision repair shops and retailers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Coatings are consumables reordered continually by OEMs, refinish shops, packagers and paint buyers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand tied to auto production, construction, industrial output and remodelling, which are cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Paints and coatings are frequent, repeat purchases of relatively small value per order.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured coatings and materials technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Key customers are automakers, aerospace companies, large industrial manufacturers and packaging producers; consumer paint is a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many global chemical manufacturing plants and research facilities needing ongoing capital investment, plus retail stores.

notes: Industrial and consumer split is approximate; the larger business is industrial and performance coatings.
